SellerName.description: Legal or trade name of the issuing business shown in the From section

SellerEmail.description: Email address of the issuing business as printed in the From section

SellerAddress.description: Mailing or street address of the issuing business as shown in the From section

SellerPhone.description: Telephone number for the issuing business as printed in the From section

BuyerName.description: Customer or recipient name shown in the For section

BuyerEmail.description: Email address of the customer shown in the For section

BuyerAddress.description: Mailing or street address of the customer as printed in the For section

BuyerPhone.description: Telephone number for the customer as shown in the For section

InvoiceNumber.description: Unique invoice identifier labeled Number used to reference this billing document

InvoiceDate.description: Calendar date the invoice was issued as labeled Date

PaymentTerms.description: Payment terms indicating due time frame or conditions as labeled Terms

DueDate.description: Calendar date by which payment is due as labeled Due

LineItems.description: Itemized list of goods or services billed including description, unit price, quantity, and line amount

Description.description: Narrative description of the product or service for the line

UnitPriceAmount.description: Unit price for the line item excluding currency symbols

Quantity.description: Number of units billed for this line

LineAmount.description: Extended amount for the line, typically unit price multiplied by quantity

SubtotalAmount.description: Sum of line item amounts before taxes, discounts, or additional charges

TaxDescription.description: Printed tax label or rate description accompanying the tax total

TaxAmount.description: Total tax amount applied to the subtotal

TotalAmount.description: Grand total due including taxes and adjustments

BalanceDueAmount.description: Outstanding balance still payable at the time of invoice issuance

Notes.description: Free-text notes or footer messages printed on the invoice
